# Section 010: Packaging Applications For GitOps

Every GitOps controller applies manifests that a packaging tool renders from Git. This section teaches Kustomize, the packaging tool built into kubectl and rendered natively by Argo CD and Flux, so the reader can produce a repeatable manifest per environment and read what an overlay will apply before any controller touches the cluster. It comes first because Argo CD, Flux and Tekton all consume this format. Helm charts appear later only as a source that Argo CD and Flux consume.

**Curriculum item covered:** Implementing GitOps Workflows for Application and Infrastructure Deployment

---

## What You Will Master

- Write a kustomization.yaml that sets a namespace, common labels and an image tag for a base
- Create staging and production overlays that patch the replica count and resources of one base
- Render an overlay with kubectl kustomize and compare it with the cluster using kubectl diff -k
- Generate a ConfigMap with configMapGenerator and explain why its name carries a hash suffix
- Diagnose a kustomize build error caused by a wrong resource path or a patch that matches no object

---

## The Learning Path

### 1. Build Environment Overlays With Kustomize
*   **Module Reader:** **[Module 1: Build Environment Overlays With Kustomize](./module-01/course.md)**
*   **Hands-on Playground:** `sections/section-010/module-01/playground` — kind cluster (Kubernetes 1.35). Namespaces `starfleet-staging` and `starfleet-production` exist and are empty; `shuttle` (curlimages/curl) runs in `starfleet` to send test requests. The reader writes every kustomization file on their own machine; kubectl's built-in kustomize is enough. Deliberately absent: no GitOps controller, no Helm release, no `scout` workload yet.
    ```bash
    astrona run --git ssh://git@github.com/astrona-io/ATS018.git -c sections/section-010/module-01/playground
    ```

### Section Capstone Challenge
*   **Comprehensive Challenge:** Packaging Applications For GitOps Capstone — `sections/section-010/capstone/labs/lab-01` *(created in the build phase)*
    ```bash
    astrona run --git ssh://git@github.com/astrona-io/ATS018.git -c sections/section-010/capstone/labs/lab-01
    astrona submit -c .
    ```
*   **Hands-on Objective:** The `scout` service must ship to staging and production from one source. Fix a broken Kustomize base and overlays so they render, set the right image tag, replica count and generated configuration per environment, and apply cleanly, proving both environments answer from `shuttle` with the expected version and message.
